description:
Analyse the head-to-head matchup between two cricket players based on role and career stats.

Args:
    player_a: CricAPI player ID for the first player (names are not resolved).
    player_b: CricAPI player ID for the second player (names are not resolved).

Returns:
    data: {matchup_type, edge_holder, edge_reason, signals, role_a, role_b}.
    meta.estimated: true — heuristic model, not ball-by-ball H2H data.

player_a.description: CricAPI player ID for the first player (names are not resolved).
player_a.title: Player A

player_b.description: CricAPI player ID for the second player (names are not resolved).
player_b.title: Player B

name: cricket_player_matchup
